UN M49 is identified as an authoritative geographic code source. DEMO and synthetic areas were not verified against UN M49.

standard_references.version: not confirmed from supplied official-source evidence
standard_references.evidence: UNSD economic classifications are identified as the place to check ISIC. Labour industry labels are local aggregates and not confirmed ISIC categories.

standard_references.version: not confirmed from supplied official-source evidence
standard_references.evidence: UNESCO ISCED is the international reference for education level. Education-level labels require review before authoritative mapping.

standard_references.version: not confirmed from supplied official-source evidence
standard_references.evidence: UNSD economic classifications are authoritative sources for products and commodities. Crop and fertilizer values require classification review.

standard_references.version: not confirmed from supplied official-source evidence
standard_references.evidence: COICOP is the relevant consumption-purpose classification to check for CPI divisions; the reports do not confirm revision or exact codes.

standard_references.version: not confirmed from supplied official-source evidence
standard_references.evidence: ISO 4217 is the standard source when currency identity is required. Trade XML states US dollars; agriculture and prices reports use unnamed local currency.

limitations: Exact SDMX Global Registry versions and code memberships for CL_FREQ, CL_SEX, CL_OBS_STATUS, CL_SEASONAL_ADJUST, CL_AREA and CL_COICOP_2018 were not confirmed in the supplied official-source evidence.

XML codelists from DEMO SDMX files were mechanically converted and represented through consolidated aggregate codelists with explicit source-codelist mappings in scope notes and code evidence. Consolidated aggregate codelist IDs are not original DEMO artefact IDs.
Northland, Centralia and South Coast are local synthetic reference areas and have no confirmed authoritative geography mapping.
Trade partner areas include countries and aggregates such as World and EU27. They are kept in a partner-area codelist separate from reference area to avoid confusing semantic roles.
Female/Women and Male/Men are consolidated as local sex-category candidates, but total-sex categories are kept distinct where report scope differs or is undefined.

Percent is consolidated as a common mathematical unit. Persons, students, deaths, beds, open positions, hectares, tonnes, GWh, generic index, base-2023 index, million US dollars and currency-denominated local units remain distinct where their statistical units differ.
Education level labels from DEMO XML and PDF reports are label-consolidated only as local/candidate mappings; no ISCED version or exact code mapping is confirmed.

Cause labels resemble ICD families, education levels resemble ISCED categories, industry labels resemble activity categories, crop and fertilizer labels resemble product classifications, CPI divisions resemble COICOP categories, and energy-source labels resemble energy classifications, but no authoritative classification versions or mappings were confirmed.

Wealth quintiles and expenditure quintiles are survey-specific and are not merged because they describe different distributions. Only quintile labels appearing in the source reports are represented; missing intermediate quintiles must not be invented.

Modelled estimate, survey estimate, observed, forecast, final, provisional, estimated and normal status labels may require methodology metadata as well as observation-status coding; they are retained as local status labels pending SDMX CL_OBS_STATUS verification.
Private-sector hospital-bed reporting is incomplete in 2024; this is an interpretive limitation for the health report and not a separate codelist category.
Hospital ownership categories are scoped to the hospital-beds structure and should not be applied to mortality data unless separately justified.
The agriculture and prices reports use unnamed local currency units, so ISO 4217 currency coding cannot be confirmed for those units.

codelists.name: CPI product/consumption groups used in source reports
codelists.source_url: not stated in source files; derived from supplied reports
codelists.scope_notes: Consolidates CPI product-group/division labels from DEMO consumer-prices XML and the PDF prices report where labels are semantically equivalent. Explicit XML mappings: CL_CPI_PRODUCT_GROUP.ALL -> ALL_ITEMS; FOOD -> FOOD_NAB; HOUSING -> HOUS_UTIL. PDF mappings: CL_LOCAL_CPI_DIVISION.FOOD_NAB, HOUS_UTIL and TRANSPORT retain the same aggregate codes. Values resemble COICOP/CL_COICOP_2018 but revision is not confirmed.

codes.name: All-items CPI

codes.local_creation_justification: No confirmed COICOP revision or code was supplied.
